snippet.title: Ananta | Gameplay Video
snippet.description:
The company going belly up immediately after reporting in for duty. Blowing up on the internet after dealing with a Maniac Chaos causing a traffic jam. Needless to say, upon arriving in Nova City, the new captain has to deal with his fair share of headaches. To top it all off, he's utterly unfamiliar with his new home. Only one thing is for certain: there are some tough days ahead. #Ananta #AnantaTGS
